## Fixes

- **Walkability painting works on levels with long folder or type names.** "This map only" edits put their blocker tiles in one tile file per level type, named after the type. On Dark Temple that name, `PD2assets/dtprivate/dark_temple_custom.dt1`, was 42 characters. The game holds at most 41, so the studio stopped with an error. The name is now shortened to fit: the underscores in the type name go first, then letters from the end. Dark Temple gets `PD2assets/dtprivate/darktemple_custom.dt1`.
